summary: @servicetitan/admin-sql-table preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execFileSync a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (rotating string-array decoder using `WV8StW` push/shift over a >2000-entry constant table, numeric-code + `String.fromCodePoint` decoding, `_0xNNNN`-style identifiers, no source-map) that is not documented in package.json and shares no code with the advertised React SQL-table component. The alternate-runtime download exists so that the opaque payload is executed under a freshly-fetched Bun binary rather than the ambient Node interpreter, and it fires automatically on `npm install` before any consumer code runs. The purpose of the package (a React SQL admin table) has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an unrelated obfuscated script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
